summary: Swiggy orchestration sends tool calls in MCP envelopes and verifies explicit read operations.
reason: Domain endpoints share transport paths. Raw arguments omit the operation, while treating all POSTs as mutations suppresses real read results in verification mode.
validated_outcome: Local mock transport tests cover the 51 endpoints: 24 classified reads reach the mock in verification mode and 27 other operations make no HTTP request.
safety: Unclassified POST operations remain behind the mutation guard; tests never call the Swiggy provider.
